title: Toward a traceable, explainable, and fair JD/Resume recommendation system

bias_targets.methodology: Proposed evaluation of dataset quality by categorizing features and analyzing how the inclusion or exclusion of age data impacts the bias of the job/resume matching algorithm.

Proposed mitigation and evaluation by ensuring diverse, heterogeneous training datasets to prevent systematic preferences or discrimination against specific genders (e.g., female applicants) in automated recruitment.
Proposed mitigation of bias against ethnic minorities in resume screening by curating multifaceted training data and utilizing explainability frameworks to audit the model's matching decisions.
